question: "India House", a revolutionary organisation, was established by Shyamji Krishna Varma in _________ for the spread of Indian Nationalism.
solution:
The correct answer is __**London.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Shyamji Krishna Varma** was a** scholar, lawyer,** and a significant figure in the **Indian independence movement.**
 
• He established **"India House" in London.**
 
• "India House" was set up in the year **1905.**
 
• It functioned as a** hostel for Indian students** studying in England.
 
• More than just a hostel, it emerged as a** central hub for the promotion of Indian nationalism** in an overseas context.
 
• "India House" played an influential role in** igniting revolutionary ideas **among young Indians, thus contributing significantly to the Indian independence movement.
